lines.text: Alamo Injury Law, this is Boris, the firm's AI assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi. I slipped on something spilled at the grocery store on Culebra. There was no wet-floor sign.
I'm sorry. When was that, and were you hurt?
Last Wednesday. I bruised my hip and sprained my wrist. I went to urgent care, and I see my doctor Friday.
Did the store write up what happened?
Yes, the manager filled out an incident report.
Thank you. Grant Whitaker, one of our attorneys, can meet with you tomorrow at 1:30. Would that work?
You're all set. I'm texting you the details.
